Exhaustive algebraic cases over an algebraic closure prove precisely 50 affine singularities. Hessian determinants on orbit representatives are 1,4,4,1 modulo 5. Infinity is a six-line arrangement with 15 simple pair intersections; their quadratic tangent cones are nondegenerate. All 65 are split A1 points and the Jacobian scheme is reduced. The bundled executable reproduced all finite certificates; finite enumeration does not establish the geometric completeness step.

value.rationale: At prime 5 the golden ratio ring is ramified and the original icosahedral symmetry is in exceptional characteristic, making collision or nonordinary specialization a real risk. The result establishes that the full 65-node complex configuration survives with all nodes split over the prime field and that its intrinsic singular scheme has exactly 65 reduced points. It is a natural exact arithmetic and scheme-theoretic invariant of a distinguished surface, not an arbitrary finite slice or a generic count.
